verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents official Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java SDKs for integrating with any agent stack. The first-party langsmith-sdk GitHub repo shows real usage such as wrapping an OpenAI client for tracing, and the SDK is also documented for calling deployed Agent Servers. Missing for 10: in-depth per-language SDK reference documentation in the pack, evidence for the Go and Java SDKs beyond a single listing, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
